```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

years <- params$years %||% numeric(0)
n <- length(rasters)
```

Assessed on `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` `r 
{
  parts <- c()
  
  if (!is.null(params$author) && nzchar(params$author))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("by ", params$author))
  
  if (!is.null(params$email) && nzchar(params$email))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("(", params$email, ")"))
  
  if (!is.null(params$organisation) && nzchar(params$organisation))
    parts <- c(parts, paste0("affiliated to ", params$organisation))
  
  if (length(parts) > 0)
    paste(parts, collapse = " ")
  else
    ""
}`

# **Report summary**

This report documents an ecosystem assessment, as part of the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems, for the `r params$ecosystem_name` `r if(length(params$years) == 0) {        "with no raster years uploaded"      } else if(length(params$years) == 1) {        paste("using data from", params$years)      } else {        paste("using data between", min(params$years), "and", max(params$years))      }`. The data behind this ecosystem assessment report has been generated machine learning models of remote sensing data as part of the EcoCAT (Ecosystem Classification Assessment Tool) project from RBG Kew.

 - The graphs can be downloaded from this report by selecting the 'download as png' icon at the top of each plot.
 - Watch this space to be able to download the maps too ......
 - To download the data and mapping files as part of this assessment, please revisit the download tab and select the required data files for download.
  

------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
# **Ecosystem description**
  
### Classification

To summarise the [IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (GET)](https://global-ecosystems.org/) of the ecosystem, the most recent (`r max(params$years)`) classification map was overlayed on the global GET maps and the percentage of each ecosystem functional group (EFG) (both major and minor occurrence) intersecting with the ecosystem was calculated.  The summary of EFGs in the mapped ecosystem is presented in the table below with '`r params$typology[1,2]`' the most prevalent major EFG. Any EFG with <1% occurrence coverage in the ecosystem is not displayed in this table. 

```{r typology, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$typology)}
typology_df <- params$typology
title_text <- "Percentage of Global Ecosystem Typology across the ecosystem"

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
htmltools::tagList(
  # centered Title
  htmltools::div(
    style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", title_text),
  DT::datatable(typology_df, rownames=F,
                escape = FALSE,
                options = list(
                  pageLength = 5,
                  searching = FALSE,
                  info = FALSE,
                  #dom = 't',
                  autoWidth = TRUE,
                  scrollX = FALSE)) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(columns = c(1:ncol(typology_df)), fontSize = '100%')
)

}else{
    # flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(font.size = 10, theme_fun = theme_vanilla, padding = 5, background.color = "transparent")
  
  get_tab <- flextable(typology_df) %>%
    set_caption(caption = as_paragraph(as_b(title_text))) %>%
    autofit() %>%
    flextable::theme_booktabs(bold_header = TRUE) %>%
    # colformat_num(j="Year", big.mark = "") %>%
    set_table_properties(layout="autofit")
  
  get_tab
  
}



```

### Abiotic variables {.tabset .tabset-pills}

#### Rainfall {.active}
**Rainfall:** Historical rainfall data was taken from [WorldClim version 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html). The average annual precipitation with the ecosystem between 1970 and 2000 was `r round(mean(params$rainfall$mean), 0)`mm. The average monthly rainfall patterns are shown in the graph below:

```{r rainfall_2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', fig.height=3, eval = !is.null(params$rainfall)}
monthly_avg <- params$rainfall

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # --- Interactive Plotly ---
  library(plotly)
  p_plot <- plot_ly(monthly_avg, x = ~month) %>%
  add_ribbons(
    ymin = ~min_smooth,
    ymax = ~max_smooth,
    line = list(color = 'transparent'),
    fillcolor = 'lightblue',
    opacity = 0.4,
    name = "95% range"
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_smooth,
    line = list(color = 'blue', width = 2),
    name = "Mean"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Average Monthly Rainfall",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Rainfall (mm)")
  )

  p_plot
} else {
  # --- Static ggplot for PDF/Word ---
   p_plot <- ggplot(monthly_avg, aes(x = month, group=1)) +
  # smoothed ribbon
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_smooth, ymax = max_smooth),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +

  # smoothed mean line
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_smooth), color = "blue", size = 1) +
    labs(title = "Average Monthly Rainfall",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Rainfall (mm)")+
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype=5, linewidth=0.5, color="grey50"))

   p_plot
}
```

#### Elevation
**Elevation:** The elevation of the mapped ecosystem in `r max(params$years)` ranged from `r as.numeric(min(values(params$elevation, na.rm = TRUE)))`m to `r as.numeric(max(values(params$elevation, na.rm = TRUE)))`m, with 95% of the ecosystem elevation between `r global(params$elevation, quantile, probs=c(0.05, .95), na.rm=T)[1]`m and `r  global(params$elevation, quantile, probs=c(0.05, .95), na.rm=T)[2]`m. The elevation distribution across the ecosystem is shown in the graph below:

## {-}
# **Risk Assessment**

### Criterion A: Reduction in geographic distribution

```{r area_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$areas) }
if (nrow(params$areas) > 1) {
    area_data <- params$areas
    area_data$Year <- as.numeric(area_data$Year)
    start_year <- min(area_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
    end_year   <- max(area_data$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
    start_area <- area_data$Area_km2[1]
    end_area   <- area_data$Area_km2[nrow(area_data)]
    change_percent <- round((end_area - start_area) / start_area * 100, 1)
  
  if (change_percent > 0) {
    trend <- "increased"
  } else if (change_percent < 0) {
    trend <- "decreased"
  } else {
    trend <- "changed"   # neutral fallback (will not say "stable")
  }
}
```

`r if (nrow(params$areas) > 1) {
paste0("Between ", start_year, " and ", end_year,  " the area of this ecosystem has ", trend, " by ",
abs(change_percent), "% from ", format(round(start_area,0), big.mark = ","), "km² to ", format(round(end_area,0), big.mark = ","),
"km². The proportional rate (% of annual area change) and absolute rate (annual change in area) are detailed in the table below.")
 } else {
 "The area of ecosystem change for criterion A could not be calculated because only a single year of data was provided. The area calculation is provided below. "
 }`

```{r area_table_2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, eval = nrow(params$areas) > 1}

               area_change = format(round(area_change, 1), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),

               absolute_rate_change = round(absolute_rate_change, 2)) %>%
   dplyr::rename(

          `Area (km²)` = area,

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {

                      colnames = c("Year", "Area (km2)", "Area change (km2)",
                                   "Proportional rate of change (%)", "Absolute rate of change (km2)"),
                      options = list(paging = FALSE, searching = FALSE, info = FALSE, dom = 't'), 
                      rownames = FALSE
        )
      )
    )
  )
  
  a_tab
  
} else {
  # flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(
    font.size = 10, theme_fun = theme_vanilla, padding = 5, background.color = "transparent"
  )
  
  a_tab <- flextable(criteria_a_data) %>%
    set_caption( caption = as_paragraph(as_b(title_text))) %>%
    autofit() %>%
    flextable::theme_booktabs(bold_header = TRUE) %>%
    colformat_num(j="Year", big.mark = "") %>%
    set_table_properties(layout="autofit")

}
```

`r if (!is.null(params$area_prediction_data)) {
  paste0("To assess the subcriteria of Criterion A, the changes in ecosystem area can be estimated for both past and present using various of methods depending on data availability. This includes quantifying the absolute change area (ARC), proportional change in area (PRC). Some of these trends are presenting the the interactive graph below."
  )
}` 

```{r area_change_graph, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5, out.width = '100%',  eval = !is.null(params$area_prediction_data)}
area_prediction_data <- params$area_prediction_data

results <- area_prediction_data %>%
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Year: ", year, "<br>",
      "Area: ", round(area,0), "<br>",
      "Scenario: ", scenario, "<br>",
      "Method: ", method
    )
  )

# Line styles for methods
linetypes <- c("PRC" = "solid", "ARC" = "dot")

# Colors for scenarios
colors <- c("median" = "#ff7f00",
            "recent" = "#e31a1c",
            "worst" = "darkred",
            "recent/worst" = "darkred",
            "past" = "steelblue")

# Start plotly
p <- plot_ly()

# Observed line
p <- p %>%
  add_trace(
    data = filter(results, type == "observed"),
    x = ~year, y = ~area, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers',
    line = list(color = 'grey20', width = 3),
    marker = list(color = 'grey10', size = 6),
    hoverinfo = 'text',
    text = ~hover_text,
    name = 'Observed'
  )

# Projected lines
proj_data <- filter(results, type == "projected")
for(scen in unique(proj_data$scenario)) {
  for(meth in unique(proj_data$method)) {
    sub <- filter(proj_data, scenario == scen, method == meth)
    p <- add_trace(
      p,
      data = sub,
      x = ~year, y = ~area, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
      line = list(color = colors[scen], dash = linetypes[meth], width = 3),
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      text = ~hover_text,
      name = paste(scen, meth, sep = "/")
    )
  }
}

# GAM smoother if enough points
n_points <- nrow(area_prediction_data)
if (n_points > 3) {
  dat <- area_prediction_data
  gam_model <- try(
    mgcv::gam(area ~ s(year, k = max(3, n_points - 2)), data=dat),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if (!inherits(gam_model, "try-error")) {
    new_years <- data.frame(year = seq(min(dat$year), max(dat$year)))
    pred_gam <- predict(gam_model, newdata = new_years, se.fit = TRUE)
    pred_gam <- data.frame(
      year = new_years$year,
      fit = pred_gam$fit,
      lwr = pred_gam$fit - 2 * pred_gam$se.fit,
      upr = pred_gam$fit + 2 * pred_gam$se.fit
    ) %>% mutate(across(c(fit, lwr, upr), ~ pmax(., 0)))

    pred_gam_before <- filter(pred_gam, year < min(dat$year))
    pred_gam_after  <- filter(pred_gam, year > max(dat$year))

    p <- p %>%
      add_trace(
        data = pred_gam_before,
        x = ~year, y = ~fit, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
        line = list(color = 'blue', width = 3, dash = 'dash'),
        showlegend = FALSE
      ) %>%
      add_trace(
        data = pred_gam_after,
        x = ~year, y = ~fit, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
        line = list(color = 'blue', width = 3, dash = 'dash'),
        name = 'GAM'
      ) %>%
      add_ribbons(
        data = pred_gam,
        x = ~year, ymin = ~lwr, ymax = ~upr,
        fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,255,0.2)',
        line = list(color = 'transparent'),
        name = '95% CI'
      )
  }
}

# Layout
p <- p %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Area"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Scenario / Method</b>"))
  )

p  # print the plotly object

```

### Criterion B: Restricted geographic distribution

#### Subcriterion B1: Restricted extent of occurrence (EOO)

```{r b1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5,  eval = !is.null(params$mcp_data)}
assessment_map <- c(
  "VU" = "Vulnerable",
  "EN" = "Endangered",
  "LC" = "Least Concern",
  "CR" = "Critically Endangered",
  "NT" = "Near Threatened"
)

 if (!is.null(params$mcp_data)) {
   b1_data <- params$mcp_data
   b1_code <- b1_data$assessment[which.max(as.numeric(b1_data$year))]
 } 

```

Subcriterion B1 is assessed by estimating the minimum convex polygon (MCP) – the smallest polygon that encompasses all known occurrences of the ecosystem. This method is consistent regardless of the resolution of the EAU mapping, allowing comparison across global ecosystems types.

`r if (!is.null(params$mcp_data)) {
  b1_data <- params$mcp_data
  b1_code <- b1_data$assessment[which.max(as.numeric(b1_data$year))]
  b1_year <- max(as.numeric(b1_data$year))
  b1_area <- formatC(
    b1_data$area_km2[which.max(as.numeric(b1_data$year))],
    format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 0
  )
  paste0(
    "A minimum convex polygon – the smallest polygon that encompasses all known occurrences of the ecosystem type – ",
    "was applied to estimate the extent of occurrence (EOO) for assessment under subcriterion B1 (B). ",
    "The area of the minimum convex polygon encompassing the most recent ecosystem map from ",
    b1_year, " was **", b1_area, " km²**. ",
    "This classes the ecosystem as **", assessment_map[b1_code],
    "** under subcriterion B1."
  )
} else {
  "The extent of occurrence (EOO) under subcriterion B1 could not be calculated because the MCP data was not created for this assessment."
}`

```{r b1_map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', eval = !is.null(params$mcp_poly)}
map_title <- "Extent of Occurrence (EOO) per year of available EAU data"
# label = ~paste0("Year: ", year, "<br>Area: ", round(area_km2,2), " km²")
mcp_list <- params$mcp_poly %||% list()


if (length(mcp_list) > 0) {
  mcp_all <- try(vect(mcp_list), silent = TRUE)
  latest_year <- max(mcp_all$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (!inherits(mcp_all, "try-error") && nrow(mcp_all) > 0) {
    if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
      # HTML Leaflet map ------------------------------------------------------
      map <- leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>%
       addPolygons(data = sf::st_as_sf(terra::project(mcp_all[mcp_all$year == latest_year, ], "EPSG:4326")),
                   fillOpacity = 0.3, color = "black", weight = 2,
                   group = paste0(latest_year, " MCP"),
                   label = ~paste0("Year: ", year, "<br>Area: ", round(area_km2, 2), " km²"),
                   highlightOptions = highlightOptions(bringToFront = TRUE, color = "white", weight = 3)) %>%
        addRasterImage(r_recent, opacity = 0.7, colors = "#000000", group = paste0(latest_year, " classification")) %>%
        addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "ESRI Satellite") %>%
        addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("OSM", "ESRI Satellite"), 
                         overlayGroups = c(paste0(latest_year, " MCP"),paste0(latest_year, " classification")) ,
            options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))
      # # return the map
      # map
      
      # Wrap the map with title
      htmltools::tagList(
        tags$div(
          style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", map_title),
        map)
      
      
      # # Add title above map
      # htmltools::tagList(
      #   tags$div(
      #     style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;",
      #     map_title
      #   ),
      #   map
      # )

    } else {
      #  PDF / Word (static map) ----------------------------------------------
      ggplot() +
        geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(terra::project(mcp_all[mcp_all$year == latest_year, ], "EPSG:4326")),
                                    aes(fill = factor(year)), alpha = 0.3) +
        #scale_fill_manual(values = pal_colors) +
        theme_minimal() +
        ggtitle(map_title) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No valid MCP data available for mapping.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No MCP vectors provided, so no B1 map can be generated.\n")
}
```

#### Subcriterion B2: Restricted area of occupancy (AOO)

```{r b2_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$aoo_sel_ids) }
sel_ids <- try(params$aoo_sel_ids, silent = TRUE) # table with year + cell_ids
all_ids <-  try(params$aoo_all_ids, silent = TRUE) # table with year + cell_ids
b2_data <- try(params$b2_data, silent = TRUE)

b2_tab <- htmltools::tagList(
  # centered Title
  htmltools::div(
    style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;",
    "Table of Area of Occupancy (AOO) for Subcriterion B2: Restricted Extent of Occurrence"
  ),

  # centrered table too
htmltools::div(
  style = "text-align:center;",
  htmltools::div(
    style = "display:inline-block; width:auto;",  # shrink to fit content
    DT::datatable(
      b2_data,
      colnames=c("Year", "Number of occupied cells",
               "Number of cells exluding smallest 1%", "Category"),
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(
        paging = FALSE,
        searching = FALSE,
        info = FALSE,
        dom = 't',
        autoWidth = TRUE,
        scrollX = FALSE)) %>%
      formatStyle(
        "assessment",
        backgroundColor = styleEqual(
          c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", "LC"),
          c("#FF0000", "#FFA500", "#FFFF00", "#ADFF2F", "#008000")),
        color = "black",
        fontWeight = "bold"
      )
  )
)
)

# assessment_map created in b1_table
b2_code <- b2_data$assessment[max(NROW(b2_data))]
```

Subcriterion B2 is assessed by estimating the area of occupancy (AOO) by counting the number of 10 km<sup>2</sup> cells covered by the ecosystem. This method is consistent regardless of the resolution of the EAU mapping, allowing comparison across global ecosystems types.

`r if (!is.null(params$b2_data)) {
  b2_data <- params$b2_data
  b2_code <- b2_data$assessment[max(NROW(b2_data))]
  
  
  e_name <- params$ecosystem_name
  b2_n <- b2_data$n[max(NROW(b2_data))]
  b2_nexceed <- b2_data$n_exceed[max(NROW(b2_data))]
  b2_code <- assessment_map[b2_code]
  
  b2_data <- params$b2_data
  b2_code <- b2_data$assessment[which.max(as.numeric(b2_data$year))]
  paste0(
    "From overlaying a 10 × 10 km grid on the ", params$ecosystem_name,
    " ecosystem, ", b2_data$n[max(NROW(b2_data))], " 10 km² grid cells intersect the most recent (",
    max(params$years), ") ecosystem map, which is highlighted in the map below. Small patches of the mapped ecosystem (<1% of total mapped ecosystem area) are then excluded from the total number of intersecting 10 km² grid cells to provide the AOO measurement. From the most recent mapping, the AOO for the ", params$ecosystem_name,
    " ecosystem is ", b2_data$n_exceed[max(NROW(b2_data))], " grid cells. This number of grid cells classes the ecosystem as **", assessment_map[b2_code], "** under subcriterion B2."
  )
  
  
} else {
  "The area of occupancy (AOO) under subcriterion B2 could not be calculated because the 10 x 10km grid data was not created for this assessment."
}`

```{r b2_map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$b2_poly)}
map_title <- paste0("Area of Occupancy (AOO) including grid cells exceeding 1% cumulative proportion in ", max(years))

# Defensive extraction of parameters
grid_sf <- try(params$b2_poly, silent = TRUE)   # sf polygons with cell_id

#colour palette
pal <- colorNumeric(palette = c("white", "black"), domain = c(1, 0), na.color = "transparent")

# Interactive Leaflet --------------------------------------------------------
# data selection of the most recent data
dat_all <- grid_sf[grid_sf$cell_id %in% all_ids$cell_ids[[1]], ]
dat_sel <- grid_sf[grid_sf$cell_id %in% sel_ids$cell_ids[[1]], ]

# map the most recent data
m <- leaflet() %>% 
  addTiles() %>%
  addRasterImage(r_recent, group = paste0(max(years), " classification"), colors = pal, method = "ngb", project = TRUE)  %>%
  addPolygons(data = dat_all, group = "10x10 km grid",
                    fillColor = "black",
                    fillOpacity = 0.2,
                    color = "black",
                    weight = .5) %>%
  addPolygons(data = dat_sel, group ="AOO (>1% occupancy)",
                    fillColor = "orange",
                    fillOpacity = 0.5,
                    color = "black",
                    weight = .5) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "ESRI Satellite") %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("OSM", "ESRI Satellite"),
                   overlayGroups = c(paste0(max(years), " classification"), '10x10 km grid', 'AOO (>1% occupancy)'),
          options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
        )


# Wrap the map with title
htmltools::tagList(
  tags$div(
    style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;",
    map_title),
  m
  )
```
